summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests a combination of pirtobrutinib, venetoclax, and rituximab in people with treatment-naive Waldenström's macroglobulinemia (WM) or lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma (LPL). Pirtobrutinib and venetoclax are taken by mouth once daily, and rituximab is given by intravenous (IV) or subcutaneous (SC) route; how long treatment lasts is not stated. The study aims to find out whether the combination is effective, but the main outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa una combinación de pirtobrutinib, venetoclax y rituximab en personas con macroglobulinemia de Waldenström (WM) o linfoma linfoplasmocítico (LPL) que no han recibido tratamiento previo. El pirtobrutinib y el venetoclax se toman por vía oral una vez al día, y el rituximab se administra por vía intravenosa (IV) o subcutánea (SC); la duración del tratamiento no se indica. El estudio busca saber si la combinación es eficaz, pero el resultado principal a medir no se indica.
who_for: Treatment-naive WM or IgM-type LPL with measurable disease.
Has at least one standard criterion requiring treatment, such as anemia, low platelets, or bulky disease.
ECOG performance status of 2 or less, with adequate blood counts and organ function.
Able to swallow pills and sign informed consent.
not_for: Prior systemic therapy for this disease.
Major bleeding or grade 3 or higher arrhythmia on a prior BTK inhibitor.
Significant heart disease, or QTcF above 470 msec.
Positive HIV test, or active hepatitis B or C infection.
Pregnancy or breastfeeding, or recent stem cell transplant or CAR-T therapy.
